newsitem.title: UK: Barclays gains after NatWest upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Barclays gains after NatWest upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Barclays Plc put on 6-1/2p to 12.28-1/2 stg after broker NatWest raised its forecast for the group and reiterated its "add" recommendation, dealers and analysts said.

NatWest lifted its figures by 50 million stg for this year and next putting its pre-tax profit estimate for 1997 to 2,534 million stg from 2,480 million and to 2,626 million stg from 2,580 million for 1998.
NatWest analyst Paul Goodhind said the increase was due to stronger trading across the board but declined to give further details.
Barclays reports results later this summer.
